label: Network / tcpdump text
instructions: Input is tcpdump text, not PCAP. A SYN, RST, unusual port, or single packet is not proof of an attack. Do not infer retransmission or connection outcome without supporting sequence context.

criteria.normal: Ordinary packet exchange, connection establishment or orderly close.
criteria.warning: Evidence of retransmission, packet loss, or an isolated rejected connection without confirmed outage.
criteria.error: Explicit unreachable destination or confirmed failed connection shown in this chunk.
criteria.security: Explicit hostile traffic or policy violation supported by packet details, not guessed from ports alone.
criteria.other: Insufficient packet sequence, uninterpretable text, or unrelated event.
